name: fbi-crime-mcp-server
description: Exposes the FBI Crime Data Explorer API — monthly UCR offense rates and counts by national, state, or agency scope, plus LEOKA officer-safety statistics via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Exposes the FBI Crime Data Explorer API — monthly UCR offense rates and counts by national, state, or agency scope, plus LEOKA officer-safety statistics via MCP.
interface.longDescription: Two callable tools expose FBI Crime Data Explorer monthly offense rates, counts, population denominators and reporting coverage at national, state or agency scope, and LEOKA officer fatality trends with circumstance, demographic, timeline and weapon detail. Runs over STDIO or Streamable HTTP. Nine retired UCR tools remain disabled on the operator landing page; no resources are registered.
